items.title: Hank Cicalo interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 30, 2022
items.q: I recorded so many great artists over my career: Shorty Rodgers, Peggy Lee, the Lennon Sisters

ctx.x: Oh gosh there were so many in those days. I’ve a name blockage but there were so many albums, albums that I did, “Tapestry,” “Rhymes and Reasons.” In all those days I really loved the big bands, I mean I really loved doing a lot of those. I recorded so many great artists over my career: Shorty Rodgers, Peggy Lee, the Lennon Sisters, I mean I worked for A&M Records for several years. I worked for Lou Adler, Merry Clayton, Gene McDaniels albums, “The Rocky Horror Show,” stuff like that.
What was it that sent you into this career? Was there some kind of moment?
